dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge spline fitting from the posterior insertion point to the apex, exhibiting a pronounced falcate curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded classification with a moderate pixel radius; lacks acute tapering at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Gradual, low-angle convex slope extending from the anterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.5:1 ratio of maximum horizontal base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple distinct indentations and a prominent triangular notch are visible along the trailing edge of the fin. Several superficial linear scars/scratches are present on the mid-lateral surface of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant specular reflections and water-film texture are visible across the lower lateral region of the fin and the adjacent dorsal surface.
